run_kilt_evaluation: run the mGENRE model to evaluate a KILT dataset and compute F1, precision, recall, and accuracy metrics
run_constrained_decoding: run the mGENRE model with trie-based constrained decoding to generate entity predictions from a candidate list
run_free_generation: run the mGENRE model in free generation mode without constrained decoding on a KILT dataset
run_candidate_filtered_evaluation: run the mGENRE model evaluation filtering candidates by language, Freebase ID, or English-only constraints
run_canonical_entity_evaluation: run the mGENRE model evaluation using canonical language-title to Wikidata ID mappings for entity prediction
